text_block_list.text:
After praying at the shrine with Agnes 
Tachyon—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I won't ask why you went out of your way 
to come to a shrine just to pray, though.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I don't know what you prayed for, but you 
must have had a reason to turn to God for 
help.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Well now, if our business here is 
finished, shall we head back?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: No, I'm just feeling a little off today.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Maybe the macrophages inside me are 
slacking off and leaving the apoptotic 
bodies behind.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Well, that was of course a completely 
contextless joke, though.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
In the first place, if something like that 
happened, it wouldn't just be a matter of 
her condition—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: ...*Sigh*, pointlessly rambling, wasn't I?

...It seems she really is feeling under 
the weather. I'd like to cheer her up 
somehow, but...
choice_data_list: I'm gonna go pray one more time!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Mm? Don't tell me you're planning to pray 
for me to get into top shape?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Even if you did something like that, it 
wouldn't mean anything.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...Heh, but that straightforwardness of 
yours is very characteristic of you, I 
suppose.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Either way, I can't just zone out forever, 
so...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I'll run an experiment for now to 
lift my spirits.

A delightful smile played on Agnes 
Tachyon's lips. It seems she's back to her 
usual self.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Well, if that satisfies you, I won't stop 
you.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
However, please do not get your hopes up 
for me today.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
At this rate, it's likely we won't get any 
useful information no matter what we do...

Agnes Tachyon let out a heavy sigh. It 
seems she wasn't able to regain her usual 
form...
